9 orders were paid using more than one payment method. Order 25 had 3 methods (bank_transfer, coupon, credit_card); the other orders each had 2.

WITH supplier_profit AS (
  SELECT
    s.s_suppkey AS supplier_id,
    s.s_name AS supplier_name,
    SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) - l.l_quantity * ps.ps_supplycost) AS profit
  FROM lineitem AS l
  INNER JOIN partsupp AS ps
    ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey
   AND l.l_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
  INNER JOIN supplier AS s
    ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
  GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name
)
SELECT
  supplier_id,
  supplier_name,
  ROUND(profit, 2) AS profit
FROM supplier_profit

ORDER BY profit DESC, supplier_name
